Subject: Inquiry: compliance add-on packaging for pilot

Hi Camila —

Thanks for the demo last week. Procurement at RedLeaf asked me to get a written breakdown of the compliance/security add-ons we discussed so we can evaluate for a Q3 pilot. Key asks from our side:

- Audit logs: pricing model (storage vs per-call), expected retention and retrieval costs, and any bundled retention tiers.
- KMS vs HSM: managed KMS pricing, HSM seat vs rental, and lead time for provisioning.
- Data residency: uplift for EU regions (we may need EU+US routing), any additional latency/SLA implications.
- HIPAA activation/onboarding: one-time fees, deliverables, and evidence handoff cadence.

We’re aiming for a 3-month pilot (approx. 200k messages, modest audit volume) and would prefer minimal one-time costs during the pilot; longer-term we will consider a committed plan. Can you send a proposal with proposed pilot concessions and a clean SOW we can circulate internally?

Please cc procurement (Evan) on anything requiring contract language.

Thanks,

Hi Paula —

Appreciate the clear asks. Below is a concise commercial proposal tailored for a 3-month pilot and a sample longer-term packaging option. I attached a pricing matrix and a draft SOW for your review.

Pilot proposal (3 months) — objective: low friction, measurable signals
- Audit logs: include first 100 GB storage + 1M indexed events free. Overages: $0.025/GB-month for storage, $0.0005/indexed-event for long-tail queries. Retrieval/egress: $0.04/GB when exported (we can cap this per-month for pilot).
- Managed KMS: $1,200/month (per-customer managed key); includes key rotation and audit exports.
- Dedicated HSM seat (optional): $6,500/month per HSM appliance (annualized rental). Provisioning lead time: 6–8 weeks for physical HSM; soft-provisioned HSM emulation available in 1–2 weeks for pilot.
- Data residency uplift: +12% monthly unit uplift for EU region serving; +8% for APAC (if used). Applies to token/compute and audit storage line items.
- HIPAA activation/onboarding: one-time $38,000 professional services (security workshop, attestation package, evidence handoff).

Pilot concessions (special pricing for RedLeaf)
- Waive the HIPAA onboarding fee for the 3-month pilot (we’ll include required playbook and evidence package at no charge).
- 50% discount on audit log storage overage rates during pilot.
- One managed KMS included for pilot (no monthly charge for first 3 months).
- DocuSign SOW + pilot schedule attached; if pilot converts to annual commit (>=12 months) within 30 days of pilot end, we’ll apply a 15% credit against the first 6 months of billed usage.

Longer-term packaging (example)
- Audit log tiers: Bronze (100GB incl), Silver (1TB incl), Gold (5TB incl) with progressively lower per-GB rates.
- KMS vs HSM: recommended approach is managed KMS for most flows; HSM recommended for highest-risk signing keys and regulatory requirements — pricing as above.
- Residency: customers can pin regions; we support cross-region replication for disaster recovery (additional replication fee).

Docs attached: auditlog-pricing-matrix.xlsx, RedLeaf_SOW_v1.pdf, pilot-schedule.pdf

Next steps:
1) If this looks directionally right I’ll route an internal approval for the pilot concession and send a DocuSign envelope for the SOW.
2) Confirm desired HSM provisioning model (none / soft-provision / physical HSM).
3) Let us know any procurement redlines we should expect (vendor terms, PO cadence).

Thanks — happy to jump on a 30-min call to walk through the matrix.

—Camila Reyes
